deploy-bot: Deployment complete — service=inference-api canary=eu1 version=release-2026-03-20
mira: thanks. starting post-deploy smoke (synth probes + kv warmup). tagging @oncall-sre and @santhosh
santhosh: noted. I'll watch kv probe p95 and batcher metrics. saw earlier tail latency when batch_size bumped from 8->16 in staging
kai: was that change in this release? I thought batch_size default stayed at 8
mira: it's in rollout config: quant-rollout-4 sets default batch_size=16 for canary traffic
santhosh: ok let's re-run the synth with batch_size=8 to compare. can you queue? (won't affect prod)
mira: queued:
```
# synth-run command
./deploy-tools/synth --env=eu1 --suite=postdeploy --overrides batch_size=8
```
deploy-bot: Synth job 789 queued by mira
oncall-sre: watching. preliminary p95 shows 22ms -> 38ms spike on first run, possibly autoscaler warmup
kai: suggestion: run two iterations: fresh warmup then steady-state. measure p95 over last 5m
mira: will run two passes, also capture kvcache hit ratio and prefix-miss rate
santhosh: if second pass looks better we can leave batch_size=16 and add a staggered warmup
mira: second run complete: p95 stabilized to 24ms, kvcache hit 93%, no 5xx. I'd call this acceptable. leaving canary pinned to release-2026-03-20
kai: please add a note in rollout doc: change_window 30m and observe p95 for 1h before full rollout
mira: added note https://redwood.internal/runbooks/releases/release-2026-03-20
oncall-sre: closing thread, will alert if regressions appear :thumbsup:
